Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game. Australia Women have registered a comprehensive win here and take a 2-1 lead in the series. They will now want to wrap up the series in the next game while India Women will hope to level the series. The fourth T20I of the series will be played on Saturday, 18th December and that game will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Alyssa Healy, the skipper of Australia Women, says that it was a great win and everyone contributed well. Adds that she is enjoying the challenge of leadership. Mentions that Brown did well after the tough start and credits Ellyse Perry and Grace Harris for the way they batted. Ends by saying that she is proud of her team.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that the bowlers did very well and credits Anjali Sarvani and Devika Vaidya for their performance. Adds that they thought they can chase this total, but in the middle, they played a few too many dot balls which proved to be the difference. Mentions that the plan was for her or Shafali Verma to stay there till the end, but the run rate crept up and they couldn't execute the plan. Ends by saying they will need to improve and come back stronger in the next game.

Ellyse Perry is the Player of the Match for her match-winning knock of 75 runs from 47 balls. She says that they used only a few batters in the first two games and it was nice to get a hit in this game. Adds that Grace Harris was exceptional with her knock. Feels that they battled hard at the right moments in the game and it was a complete team effort. Shares it she enjoys any opportunity to play for Australia and it was good to get a comprehensive win.
Presentation Time...

Darcie Brown is in for a flash interview. She says that her start with the ball wasn't ideal but she is glad that they managed to get the win. Adds that they were confident of defending this total with their bowling attack. Feels that it was all about backing their strengths. Shares that the new ball wasn't slippery at all and it was her wrist position that was off. Ends by saying that she enjoyed bowling here with the amount of bounce and swing on offer.

Earlier in the innings, after being put to bat first Australia Women posted a fighting total on the board thanks to a brilliant innings from Ellyse Perry and a couple of cameos from Beth Mooney and Grace Harris. India Women, at one point looked good to chase this, but Australia Women bowlers showed their quality and defended this brilliantly to register a good win for them.

Australia Women have put on a clinical bowling performance here and they have shown why they have been so consistent in this format. Darcie Brown started the first over by bowling a lot of wides, but she came back in her second over to get rid of Smriti Mandhana. They did struggle to break the stand between Harmanpreet Kaur and Shafali Verma and also gave both of them a couple lives as well, but once they did, they did not India Women come back in the game. Ashleigh Gardner and Darcie Brown picked up a couple each while Nicola Carey and Megan Schutt contributed with one wicket each. They showed a lot of character in this game and now will go to the next game with a 2-1 lead.

India Women did not start the chase that well as they lost Smriti Mandhana quite early. It was Harmanpreet Kaur and Shafali Verma who recovered after that and stitched up a good partnership of 73 runs. When these two were batting, it looked like they will chase this down easily. However, Shafali Verma got to her fifty and then got out which started a collapse as they lost three wickets in the space of nine balls. Harmanpreet Kaur remained on the other end, but she too fell after playing a few more lusty blows. Deepti Sharma played a cameo, but in the end the total proved to be too big and they fell short by 21 runs. India Women will feel that they let this one slip away from them and now they have to win the next game to stay alive in the series.
Australia Women take a 2-1 lead in the series! They were brilliant all around and in the end it was a pretty convinvning win for them. India Women, will need to comeback stronger in the next game.
On a length on middle by Megan Schutt, Anjali Sarvani whips this one to deep mid-wicket for a single. Australia Women win by 21 runs!
Short and on middle, Deepti Sharma shimmies down the track and pulls this uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length outside off, Deepti Sharma goes for a hoick across the line but gets an inside edge back onto her pads.

Fullish on off, Deepti Sharma uses her feet and drills it down to mid off. The fielder there dives to prevent the boundary. She parries the ball away to mid on which allows Deepti Sharma to come back for the second.
Short of a length on middle, Anjali Sarvani works this one towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Anjali Sarvani is the next batter in.

OUT! Run out! Back of a length on off, Radha Yadav makes room to go through covers but gets an inside edge that rolls to the left of the bowler. Radha Yadav wants a single and is halfway down the track, Megan Schutt gets to the ball quickly and hits at the non-striker's end with an underarm throw to catch Radha Yadav short of the crease.
Megan Schutt (3-0-18-1) to bowl the last over.

FOUR! On a length on off, Deepti Sharma shimmies down the track and drives this one firmly to Tahlia McGrath at cover who fails to stop it and concedes a boundary. India Women need 27 off the last over.
Cutter, touch fuller outside off, Deepti Sharma advances and swats this one wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is full again and on leg, Deepti Sharma uses her feet and wristily whips it away towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller one and on leg, Deepti Sharma clips it with soft hands towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for India Women! This is full and on leg, Deepti Sharma goes down and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length and on off, Radha Yadav heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nicola Carey to bowl out now.
Short and outside off, Deepti Sharma crouches to pull this one but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
On a length outside off, Radha Yadav goes for a slog but mishits it to square leg for a dot.
Touch fuller on off, Deepti Sharma uses her feet and drives this one to long off for a single.
Short of a length and angling in, Deepti Sharma goes for the cut but gets an inside edge back onto her body.
Back of a length on off, Deepti Sharma cuts it straight to backward point for a dot.
Fullish on middle, Radha Yadav drives this one down to long on for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner (2-0-18-2) comes back into the attack now.
Low full toss on middle, Deepti Sharma whips this one wide of long on and collects a couple of runs.
Back of a length on middle, Radha Yadav pushes it to mid off and rushes for a single.
Full on off, Radha Yadav slaps this one back past the bowler and the ball clatters into the stumps off Deepti Sharma's pads. No run taken.
Slower and short outside off, Radha Yadav can only push it to cover for a dot.
Radha Yadav walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Cutter on a length outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur shuffles across to slog this one towards deep mid-wicket but ends up holding out to Annabel Sutherland at long on who makes no mistake.  India Women are in a lot of trouble now!
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Cutter, full on off, Deepti Sharma clips this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Megan Schutt (2-0-14-0) is back on.

FOUR! DROPPED! On a length on off by Nicola Carey, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and frees her arms to go over covers but ends up hitting it towards Ellyse Perry at long off who runs around but fails to hang onto it.
WIDE! Nicola Carey sees Harmanpreet Kaur back away and follows her but Harmanpreet Kaur moves to the off side and leaves it alone.
Back of a length on off, Harmanpreet Kaur backs away to cut but gets an iniside edge and the ball rolls on the off side for a dot.
Short and outside off, Deepti Sharma pulls this one along the ground to deep square leg for a single.
Slower on a length on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room to go down the ground miscues this one past the bowler for a single.
Short of a length on off, Deepti Sharma works this one off the back foot to deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
On a length on off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for a slog across the line but gets it from the inner part of the bat towards square leg for a single.
Shortish and on off, Deepti Sharma pushes it towards covers.
Deepti Sharma is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Ashleigh Gardner get another in this over! Richa Ghosh holes out now, and Australia Women are right back on top here. This is floated, full and on leg, Richa Ghosh goes down and slog-sweeps it, but miscues it in the air towards long on where Annabel Sutherland takes a good catch. This is a huge wicket for Australia Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur slog-sweeps it on the bounce towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is tossed up, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the drive, but gets an outside edge towards the vacant thrid man fence for a boundary.
Floated, full and on off, Richa Ghosh drives it through covers for a single.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Ashleigh Gardner strikes now! Devika Vaidya goes back to the hut. This is tossed up, full and on middle, Devika Vaidya looks to work it away, but the ball spoons off the inner half towards the bowler where Ashleigh Gardner takes a dolly. They are appealing for the catch, and Devika Vaidya starts to walk back. The umpires sends it upstairs to check if it is bump-ball, but the replays shows it is clearly out. India Women lose another.
Ashleigh Gardner (1-0-12-0) comes back on.
Short and on middle, Devika Vaidya pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and on off, Devika Vaidya mistimes her cut towards the bowler.
Full and on off, Devika Vaidya drives it towards mid off.
Devika Vaidya is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Shafali Verma is gone! Nicola Carey gets a huge breakthrough for Australia Women. She bowls this short and on middle, angling in, Shafali Verma goes for the pull shot, but mistimes it high in the air towards deep mid-wicket where Ashleigh Gardner keeps her eyes on the ball and takes a nice catch under pressure. Shafali Verma has to make that long walk back right after scoring her fifty. India Women three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashleigh Gardner b Nicola Carey

Commentary.Commentary: Short and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur whips it towards the deep mid-wicket fence where the fielder dives to her right, but fails to stop it from going to the boundary.
Nicola Carey (1-0-12-0) comes on to bowl.
Darcie Brown bangs another bouncer, on off, Shafali Verma moves across and tries to hook, but misses.

FOUR! SMASHED! FIFTY FOR VERMA! This is full and on middle, Shafali Verma drills it down the ground towards long on where Annabel Sutherland lets it through for a boundary. This has been a good knock from her and she will look to make it big now.
Darcie Brown bangs in a bouncer, on middle and leg, Shafali Verma goes for the pull shot, but fails to connect.
Darcie Brown naisl the yorker, on middle, Shafali Verma swings, but misses as the ball crashes onto the stumps. It is a Free Hit, so no harm down.

Chaos in the middle! Darcie Brown bowls a slower dipping full toss, on off, Shafali Verma reaches for it and slices it uppishly straight into the hands of Tahlia McGrath at covers. Australia Women are celebrating, but the umpires are checking the no ball. The replay shows that Brown has overstepped. Shafali Verma survives and Free Hit coming up...
Full and outside off, Shafali Verma makes room, but mistimes her drive towards mid off.
A slower one, on a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur taps it towards covers and scampers across for a single.
Darcie Brown (3-0-13-2) is back on.
Short again and on off, Shafali Verma punches it towards point again.
Short and outside off, Shafali Verma cuts it towards point.
FOUR! Shafali Verma finds the fence this time! This is short and outside off, Shafali Verma moves back quickly and pulls it between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and leg, Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Two in a row! This is floated, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur nails her sweep towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Classy shot! This is looped up, full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur stays there and drills it through covers for a boundary. That brings up the 50-run partnership between these two batters.
This is on a hard length and outside off, Shafali Verma uses her feet and goes for the cut, but gets an bottom edge onto the ground and towards the keeper.
Sharp bowling! Ellyse Perry bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Shafali Verma goes for the upper cut, but misses.
Back of a length and outside off, Shafali Verma slaps it towards mid off.
Short again and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it hard but straight towards deep mid-wicket. They cross.
Short and on middle, Shafali Verma gets hurried and mistimes her pull shot towards long on for a single.
Ellyse Perry starts with a full delivery, on the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick as the ball rolls of her pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Ellyse Perry comes into the attack now.
Short and on leg, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls this one uppishly towards deep square leg for a single.

Stumping missed by Alyssa Healy! Tossed up nicely on leg, Harmanpreet Kaur shimmies down the track to go down the ground but misses. She is way out of her crease but Alyssa Healy fails to gather it cleanly and Harmanpreet Kaur survives.
Short and at the pads by Alana King, Shafali Verma goes back and works this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and quicker on off, Shafali Verma goes for the cut but misses.
Tossed up, fuller on leg, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and drives this one towards long off for a single.
Short and on middle by Alana King, Shafali Verma goes back and pushes this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Alana King is back on. She conceded 10 runs in her first over.
Tossed up on a length outside off, Shafali Verma gets forward and drills this one down the ground towards long on for a single.
Short and quicker on off, Shafali Verma works it to backward point for a dot.
SIX! CRUNCHED! Tossed up outside off, right in the arc of the batter, Shafali Verma gets down on one knee and slogs this one over long on for a maximum.
Short and on middle, Shafali Verma rocks back and pushes this one uppishly towards the bowler. Luckily for Shafali Verma it falls short of Ashleigh Gardner.
Flighted, on a length on off, Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet and pushes it to long on or a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off by Ashleigh Gardner, Harmanpreet Kaur opens the bat face and guides this one towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Another short delivery on middle by Nicola Carey, Shafali Verma advances and slaps this one wide of long on. The fielder there puts in a dive to her right but cannot prevent the boundary.
Good-length outside off, Shafali Verma looks to drive this one on the up but gets an outside edge that falls short of the short third man fielder.
On a length and outside off, Shafali Verma guides this one straight to backward point for a dot.
FOUR! Short and punished! Halfway down the track on middle, Shafali Verma gets into the positon early and pulls this one right in the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Touch fuller and slanting down the leg side by Nicola Carey, Shafali Verma lets the ball come to her and works this one behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Nicola Carey starts with a length delivery outside off, Shafali Verma uses her feet and drives it straight to cover for a dot.
Nicola Carey comes into the attack now.
Short and on off by Alana King, Shafali Verma rocks back and punches this one towards long on for a single.
Flighted, full on off, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it with a straight bat back to the bowler.
On a length on middle and turning away, Shafali Verma pushes it to the right of the bowler and takes a single.
SIX! BANG! Floated, full outside off, Shafali Verma gets into the position early and slogs this one towards long on. Clears the fence with ease and collects a maximum.
Tossed up, full on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur gets forward and pushes it to long on for a single.
Alana King to bowl her leggies now.
Fuller on middle by Megan Schutt, Harmanpreet Kaur works this one to deep square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Back of a length on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the flick but misses and gets hit high on the pads.

DROPPED! Slower and into the wicket on middle by Megan Schutt, Shafali Verma goes for the pull towards deep mid-wicket. Miscues this one high in the air towards Ashleigh Gardner dives forward and fails to hang onto it.
Fullish delivery on middle and swinging in, Shafali Verma advances and drives it straight to mid off for a dot.
Fullish delivery down the leg side, Shafali Verma goes for the flick but misses.

SIX! SHOT! Shafali Verma welcomes Megan Schutt with a six! Cutter on a length and on off, Shafali Verma uses her feet and frees her arms to go through with the shot. Swings this one over long off for a maximum.
Back of a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards point. There is some confusion in the middle, but no harm done.
Short of a length and outside off, shaping away, Harmanpreet Kaur tries to poke at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.

OUT! LBW! Darcie Brown strikes again! Jemimah Rodrigues has to go back after playing a quick cameo. Darcie Brown bowls this a touch fuller and on off, shaping in a bit, Jemimah Rodrigues prods forward to defend it, but plays down the wrong line and get rapped around her pads. There is an appeal for LBW, and the umpire after some thinking raises the finger. Jemimah Rodrigues is dissappointed, but it seems to be a good decision. India Women lose their second.
On a good length and on leg, Shafali Verma goes for the flick, but chips it uppishly just over square leg. They cross.
Fuller one and on off, Shafali Verma drives it well, but find the fielder at cover-point.
Back of a length and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it towards third man for a single.
Short and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it towards square leg where a misfield allows the batter a run. 14 runs off the over!
FOUR! Two in a row! Annabel Sutherland bowls the slower delivery, full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues waits for it and drills it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! This is on a good length and around leg, Jemimah Rodrigues stays there and clips it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Annabel Sutherland strays in her line and bowls this full and down the leg, Jemimah Rodrigues misses her flick and the ball kisses her pads to go towards the keeper.
FOUR! Innovative and effective! This is short and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues bends down a bit and ramps it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Annabel Sutherland starts with a good-length delivery, on middle, Shafali Verma whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Annabel Sutherland is introduced into the attack.
Darcie Brown pulls her length back a bit, on the pads this time, Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it towards deep square leg for a brace and gets off the mark.
Full again and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues drives it firmly, but straight to covers.
Full and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues defends it down the pitch.
Short of a length and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it out.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks in at number 3 for India Women.

OUT! TAKEN! Darcie Brown gets a huge wicket! Smriti Mandhana goes early and Australia Women are delighted. Darcie Brown bowls this on a hard length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana goes for the big heave across the line, but gets a top edge straight up in the air. Annabel Sutherland at mid off settles under and takes a good catch. India Women lose their first.
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Darcie Brown bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Smriti Mandhana ducks underneath it.
This is on a good length and on off, Shafali Verma knocks it towards mid off.
Fuller one and around off, Smriti Mandhana drives it towards covers for a run.
Back of a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and forces it towards mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Shafali Verma drives it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Shafali Verma gets off the mark in style! This is on a hard length and on middle, Shafali Verma stays there and thrashes it towards the long on fence for a boundary.
Megan Schutt starts with a short delivery, slower too, Shafali Verma gets surprised a bit and withdraws her pull shot as the ball loops up of the top edge to the off side.
It will be Megan Schutt to bowl from the other end.
On a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts it towards cover.
Short of a length and outside off, way outside off, Smriti Mandhana once again leaves it alone. Darcie Brown has to bowl it again as it is called a wide again.
Darcie Brown serves this full and outside off, manages to keep it inside the wide line this time. Smriti Mandhana lifts her bat and leaves it alone.
This is on a good length and outside off, angling away, Smriti Mandhana lets it go to the keeper. Wided.
This is on a yorker length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana offers no shot at it.
Another wide! Darcie Brown is trying to get the ball back in from way outside off. She bowls this on a length and outside off again. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Back of a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts it towards point.
Full and on off, Smriti Mandhana drills it towards mid off.
On a length and way outside off, again, Smriti Mandhana lets it go to the keeper. Wided.

FIVE WIDES! India Women are underway! Darcie Brown loses her line and bowls this full and way outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone and Alyssa Healy behind the stumps fails to stop it as well. The ball races towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Darcie Brown comes around the wicket and starts with a full delivery, on middle, shaping in, Smriti Mandhana drives it towards covers.
